taskPrompt: Open the configured public events page and capture a traceable HTTPS runtime screenshot.

fixture.test: Day 25 captures the current public HTTPS site

rubric.criterion: The browser reaches the page and verifies stable visible UI within the 30-second test timeout.

baseline.error: page.goto timed out while waiting for networkidle; the public page itself was not proven unavailable.

change.after: page.goto(url, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" }) followed by visible heading and search button assertions
change.reason: A public page can keep background requests active. DOM readiness plus product-specific assertions measures the required evidence more directly.

limitations: This is not an Agent evaluation and does not measure Tool selection quality.
This is not WebMCP capability or invocation evidence; it only validates the public browser capture harness.
